name: Waterskin
bonus: +1 to endure heat, thirst, or a long climb.

name: Shovel
bonus: +1 Brute to dig, pry, or turn over a heap.

name: Hammer
bonus: +1 Brute in a fight, and to break something small.

name: Rope, 50 ft
bonus: +1 to any climb, and to lower someone down a shaft.

name: Quill and ink
bonus: +1 Erudite to copy a map, a rune, or a room number.

name: Crowbar
bonus: +1 Brute to force a door, a lid, or a gibbet.

name: Parasol
bonus: +1 Skulker to break a fall or hide what you are carrying.

name: Rose incense
bonus: +1 Erudite to call, calm, or bargain with a spirit.

name: Black mallet
bonus: +1 Brute for smashing stone, doors, and idols.

name: Lock pick
bonus: +1 Skulker on locks, latches, and cages.

name: Lantern
bonus: +1 to see anything that is not blue.
note: Lit, you are the most visible thing in the room.

name: Tusk spear
bonus: +1 Brute, and long enough to keep a pelican at arm's length.

name: Shield
bonus: +1 to block, brace a door, or shelter someone.

name: Torch
bonus: +1 Skulker in the dark.
note: It burns out when the referee says so.

name: Bear trap
bonus: +1 to hold a doorway against something heavy.

name: Compass
bonus: +1 Erudite to work out which way a window really faces.

name: Mirror
bonus: +1 to look round a corner without being the thing that gets looked at.

name: Rations
bonus: A meal each.
note: Eaten somewhere quiet, or not at all.

name: Cloak
bonus: Your colour, your choice.
note: Pick blue and nobody sees it after the first hour. Including you.

name: Knife
bonus: +1 in a close fight. Everyone has one.

name: Grappling hook
bonus: +1 to catch a chain from a window ledge.

name: Chalk
bonus: +1 Erudite to keep track of rooms you have already walked.

name: Flask of oil
bonus: Burns, or makes a floor treacherous. Pick one.

name: Brass spyglass
bonus: +1 Erudite to read a distant window number or count giants.

name: Twin knives
bonus: +1 Brute or Skulker in a knife fight.

name: Light crossbow
bonus: +1 Skulker at range.

name: Slim book of kastromancy
bonus: +1 Erudite on the Spire's own magic.

name: Bag of salt
bonus: Superstition, made portable.

name: Ring of water breathing
bonus: Breathe water indefinitely.
note: Room 1, on a skeletal finger. Drowning stops being one of the ways this tower can kill you.

name: Defender's blade
bonus: +1 Brute, and +1 again when you are fighting for someone else.

name: Plate armour
bonus: Absorbs 2 damage. -1 Skulker.
note: Room 7. Most of a suit. The rest is still in the fountain.

name: Venomous quills
bonus: Thrown, Skulker DS 8. A hit does 4 extra as the venom works.
note: Room 9, lodged in a pelican jawbone.

name: Potion of leaping
bonus: One enormous jump. Window to window, or roof to boat.

name: Circlet of clear sight
bonus: The wearer sees blue.
note: Rooms 16-17, in a silver sack. Sky-blindness does not touch you. Nobody else will believe what you describe.

name: Sack of silver
bonus: A year's wages.
note: Two hands, or a strap, and a bad climb. Climbing a chain with one is DS 12.

name: Silver drinking bowl
bonus: A month's wages.
note: A giant's cup. The size of a shield.

name: Smoked lake-fish
bonus: Restores 2 HP if eaten somewhere quiet.

name: Cut chain, 12 ft
bonus: +1 to climbs, and jams a door shut.
note: Heavy. Rust comes off on everything.

name: Torn tower map
bonus: Shows three rooms in the correct order.
note: Which three is the referee's business.

name: Cracked hand-mirror
bonus: +1 Erudite to look at something you must not look at directly.

name: Goblin's tooth-pouch
bonus: The shaman wants it back badly.
note: Leverage, if anyone works out what it is for.
